topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Hallmarks and Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the course context, learning objectives, and the framework of cancer hallmarks in relation to tumor progression.

topics.label: Deregulation of Growth Signaling Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase, Wnt/beta-catenin, and TGF-beta cascades confer growth signal autonomy and resistance to inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation Blocks in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how oncogenic mechanisms arrest terminal cell differentiation across hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal epithelial carcinomas.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how mutations altering p53 regulation and the balance of Bcl-2 family proteins allow cancer cells to evade programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Control
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere dynamics and p53 stress signaling regulate cellular senescence and how cancer cells bypass proliferative limits through telomerase activation.

topics.label: Metabolic Reprogramming in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine aerobic glycolysis through the Warburg effect, metabolic rewiring across different tumor types, and the epigenetic consequences of oncometabolites.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how developing tumors overcome oxygen diffusion limits by activating the angiogenic switch to stimulate blood vessel growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Genetics of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the multistep metastatic cascade, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, clinical biomarkers, and the genomic characteristics of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Conclusion and Lecture Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the session by summarizing hallmark convergence, highlighting follow-up reading, and inviting questions.
